hcahus.name: H.C. Andersens Hus
hcahus.slogan: Twelve fairy tales to walk through, mostly underground.
hcahus.line: Kengo Kuma's museum of 2021 is two-thirds underground and ends inside the little yellow house where Andersen was born.

egeskov.name: Egeskov Castle
egeskov.slogan: A Renaissance castle afloat on a forest of oak.
egeskov.line: Egeskov means oak forest, and legend says a whole forest of oaks went into the piles under its 1554 walls.

aeroeskoebing.name: Ærøskøbing
aeroeskoebing.slogan: Hollyhocks, crooked cottages and cobbles on a sleepy island.
aeroeskoebing.line: Its one-storey houses date back to 1645, and the town won the Europa Nostra heritage prize in 2002.

ladby.name: Ladby Viking Ship
ladby.slogan: A chieftain's longship, buried with his dogs and horses.
ladby.line: Found in 1935 by a pharmacist, it is the only Viking Age ship burial ever discovered in Denmark.

fynskelandsby.name: The Funen Village
fynskelandsby.slogan: Half-timbered Funen, moved beam by beam to one meadow.
fynskelandsby.line: Founded in 1942, it gathers 25 old buildings from across Funen, including a 1692 parsonage farmhouse and a watermill.
